default: a hull tipped on its side against the sand, ribs bared to the tide line
coils of thick rope anchoring block and tackle to driven stakes
barrels of pitch and tallow set out along the beach
driftwood fires smoking beneath cauldrons of tar
the tide line marked by a scatter of barnacles and weed
age_of_sail: a spare set of sails laid out to dry across the dunes
a longboat drawn up above the tide line
a lookout perched on a dune, watching the horizon

situations.text: scraping barnacles from an exposed hull
patching a breach in the planking with pitch and oakum
racing to finish before the tide turns
resting in the shade of the tipped hull, sharing water
keeping watch from atop a dune for approaching sails
an argument over who owes a turn at the pitch pots
hurrying to right the hull as a storm builds offshore
hauling the righted hull back into the water together
